children: MSC Industrial appointed Robert Kuhns as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, effective September 14, 2026, with Greg Clark resigning as Interim CFO and reverting to Vice President of Finance and Corporate Controller.
Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
Interim Chief Financial Officer (resigned); Vice President of Finance and Corporate Controller (continuing)
Resigned as Interim CFO; continuing in prior role
Will continue as Vice President of Finance and Corporate Controller

Age 52; formerly VP & CFO of TopBuild Corp. (Mar 2022–Jul 2026); VP, Controller at TopBuild (Jul 2018–Mar 2022); prior finance roles at Mohawk Industries, NCH Corporation, Ingersoll Rand. Offer: $650,000 base; 85% bonus target; equity awards; sign-on RSUs; severance and CIC plans.
Served as Interim Chief Financial Officer since August 2025; will continue as VP of Finance and Corporate Controller.
